description.text: Eight single attacks (0.94 each), [ATK and DEF +35%] to the user for 25 seconds, grants [Haste], [High Runic] and [Burst Mode] to the user

description.name: High Runic
description.text: Taunts single-target BLK and WHT attacks, absorbs BLK and WHT attacks to restore 1 consumed ability use

description.name: Burst Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands, ATK, DEF, MAG, RES, MND, ACC and EVA +20%, SPD +10%
